text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm, hmm~♪ —Alright, the side dishes are 
all set.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Cesario. Hard at work so early 
in the morning?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Fuji-san. I promised to make 
character bento boxes for my classmates.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Character bento, huh? Sounds fun. What 
kind of designs are you making?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to match their images. For 
Craft—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FLASH, KABOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Cesario!! That flashed so bright 
just now, didn't it?! So flashy!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm getting so excited!! 
Alllllriiight!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: One more lap!! Let's gooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
She loves thunder so much, after all. I 
thought I'd craft a thunder god for her 
using shredded egg crepes and cheese.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As for Messiah-san, the other day when I 
visited her room—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...! This moss terrarium looks just 
like a miniature forest.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Seeking to recreate that unique 
tranquility and soothing atmosphere found 
in the woods... I took great care with the 
layout.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is a favorite piece of mine. Just 
gazing at it cleanses my mind.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In that case, shall we make today a 
viewing session? We can sip tea while 
admiring the terrarium.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
She put so much heart and soul into 
creating it, so I thought I'd recreate the 
terrarium using green seaweed flakes and 
tsukudani.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And for Heart-san, from when we visited 
the reptile cafe recently...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so stiff. All the cuties here are 
super friendly, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! ...Snakes, iguanas, there are 
so many different kinds.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Out of all of them, my top 
recommendation is Catherine the chameleon!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look, right there on the perch. Aren't her 
swirly eyes totally cute?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, she really is charming♪ 
So I'm thinking of creating a chameleon 
character with broad bean rice.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Infusing precious memories into each and 
every one like that... You really are 
remarkably thoughtful.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The little ponies are going to be 
thrilled. After all, love is the best 
seasoning you could possibly add.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, perhaps you have the makings of a 
true entertainer? You possess a genuine 
talent for bringing joy to others, 
Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rooftop, during lunch break. Hearing 
lively voices, I turned to look—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what a surprise! Isn't this that 
sweetheart from the cafe?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To think my moss terrarium could be 
recreated in such exquisite detail with 
green seaweed and tsukudani... It feels 
almost a waste to eat it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Can I take a photo of this 
thunder god?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Of course. But make sure you eat it all 
afterwards, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thank you, Cesario! Next time we'll 
make character bento for you!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What motif should we choose? Since you 
collect fèves, perhaps we could recreate 
those...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you love eel, right! 
How about drawing with sauce and nori?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's just put all of it on top! 
Everything Cesario loves!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that sounds delightful! I can't 
wait to see your bento, everyone~!
